cohort: The study analyzed placental tissue samples from women with uncomplicated oocyte donation (OD) and naturally conceived (NC) pregnancies, as well as OD and NC pregnancies complicated with preeclampsia.
finding: The study revealed altered protein and mRNA expression of immune checkpoint ligands (PD-L1, CD200) and IDO in placentas of oocyte donation pregnancies, both uncomplicated and preeclamptic, suggesting a contribution to the increased risk for preeclampsia.
